planner.reason: Cost-aware planning and task decomposition; raise effort only for demonstrated ambiguity.

coder.reason: Balanced default for implementation; explicit high-effort escalation for difficult native/security reasoning.

tester.reason: Focused test execution and evidence; escalate complex failures rather than speculative repairs.

reviewer.reason: Independent correctness review with deeper reasoning, avoiding Astra on routine review.

critic.reason: Reserved for approved large/high-risk milestones; no automatic call after each small task.
